Implemented the streaming UTF-8 and line-ending fixes:

- `ChunkDecoder.feed()` now preserves incomplete UTF-8 sequences across chunks.
- `LineReader.end()` preserves a lone trailing CR as line content while still returning no extra line after a trailing newline.

`node --test tests/visible.test.mjs` passed (1 test). Additional checks for split multibyte characters, CRLF, lone CR, empty lines, trailing newlines, and invalid UTF-8 also passed.
